home.title: What you may say online — checked before you publish.
home.lead: For a self-employed shop, studio, or consultancy with a public site and no marketing team. Build a company brain from your URL, export files you own, and run five checks on every draft. AI does not publish for you.
home.perkCut: Truth in files you own — brain/ and brain.zip from the wizard; not trapped in our cloud
home.perkYes: Check before publish — /check flags prices, proof, titles, sources, and unsafe CTAs
home.perkAfter: Human-in-the-loop — nothing ships in the open core without your yes; no auto-blog
home.perkSame: Same base from the wizard or the CLI
home.antiPosition: Not a CRM or a 24/7 AI team. We govern what is true in your marketing.

story.title: Your site → facts → review → export.
story.lead1: Point the wizard at your public URL. You get a draft of what you sell, who it is for, and what must stay [CONFIRM]. You edit it; then export brain.zip or save a hosted profile for /check.
story.lead2: Developers use the CLI and local read-only MCP on brain/ in git. Claude and other clients can use POST /mcp when the server is configured with a Bearer key.
story.priceExample: Price gap. The site said the price was on request. The draft wrote from €99. In the notes that line stays: Price: [CONFIRM]. The 99 is not published.
story.proofEmpty: Empty, until a real client agrees to be named.
story.visualDraftText: Thank you, Ana. From the folder: what you sell and who it is for.
story.visualLowText: One star. I want a refund.
story.visualSuggestText: Thank you, Luis. I will reply myself.
story.step1Body: The wizard reads your URL and drafts facts and gaps. scan_business_website on POST /mcp does the same into a temporary hosted profile — public URLs only, stored on the server until you export.
story.step2Body: Paste copy into /check or use check_draft_before_publish. Five checks catch invented prices, weak proof, bad titles, missing sources, and unsafe CTAs. Green means review — not auto-publish.
story.step3Body: Download brain.zip for git. Commercial content workers stay in a pending queue; Telegram and MCP tools do not push to your blog. You approve; then a human publishes.
story.step4Title: The wizard is how you start
story.step4Body: Paste the public site, correct the draft, and export brain.zip. Nothing goes live until you say yes.
story.faqMcpQ: Is remote MCP open to anyone?
story.faqMcpA: No. On production, POST /mcp expects Authorization: Bearer MCP_API_KEY — without a key on the server, requests fail closed (401). scan_business_website writes a temporary hosted profile on disk; export via the wizard to own files. Local stdio MCP on your repo stays read-only for brain/.
story.faqGitA: In git. The wizard and the CLI export the same pack. The MCP server does not create, edit, or delete facts.
story.faqLiveA: After you say yes. A price, a client, or a claim that is not in the folder is cut or marked [CONFIRM].
story.extractTitle: Paste your URL in the wizard. Edit before you trust the draft.
story.extractLead: We read public titles, headings, and body text — not your private repos. Facts and open questions land on the map; gaps stay [CONFIRM] until you fill them.
story.extractMuted: Operators: local MCP and CLI (learn/10-mcp). Claude via Streamable HTTP: learn/14-claude-mcp — Bearer key required on the server in production.
story.synced: Nodes synced from your wizard draft
story.sample: Sample after URL extract · FACTS and GAPS highlighted ·

company.title: Five checks your next post must pass.
company.lead: Before a blog post or LinkedIn caption goes live, run the same list the site uses. Built for a business with a public website and no marketing department. The open wizard and /check are free; hands-on setup is quoted after a call.
company.stepsTitle: From your site to a draft you recognize
company.step1: Paste the public URL and get a draft.
company.step2: Cross out any service, price, or deadline you do not sell.
company.step3: Write who you serve, and what you will not claim.
company.step4: Ask a client question. The answer can use only the notes.
company.step5: If the draft sounds like you, an article can follow. The LinkedIn post waits until the article is published. Both wait for your yes.
company.checksLead: If one fails, the draft stays put.
company.check1: Title — would a customer Google this problem in your words, not ours?
company.check2: Prices — every pack or fee is in your brain facts; otherwise it is cut or [CONFIRM].
company.check3: Proof — rankings, numbers, or named clients only if you can show them on a live page.
company.check4: Sources — each claim traces to your site, your service list, or your notes.
company.check5: CTA — ask them to write; no invoices, passwords, or personal mobile numbers.
company.firstArticle: The first piece that used this list:
company.articleTitle: How to stop my blog posting a price I do not charge
company.core1: OSS: wizard export, /check, and local read-only MCP — no auto-publish to your blog.
company.core2: Remote MCP: scan and check tools; production needs Bearer MCP_API_KEY on the server.
company.core3: Commercial loop: drafts queue for your yes; workers do not push live without a human deploy.
company.price: The open folder is free. Setup, the start call, and the written agreement are quoted. [CONFIRM: fee or range.]
company.connectors: Connectors that would publish on their own, after the yes, are still in preparation. This page does not open that list.

It is not a new offer. An agent is the program that will draft from these notes later. This step only prepares the draft. You correct it. Nothing is published here.
